name: control_command
description: Execute command in CMD or SSH remote session. Supports cmd2(Windows) or ssh(Linux/Mac) sessions. Returns exit code, stdout, and stderr.

session_id.description: Remote control session ID (cmd2 or ssh session)

name: control_connect
description: Initiate remote control session with a device. Supports file, desktop, cmd2, ssh, desktop_view, newcamera, forward. Returns session_id for subsequent operations. Use remote_id for devices in your account (from device_search) or fastcode for other devices (9-10 digit code provided by user). Either remote_id or fastcode is required.

fastcode.description: Fastcode (9-10 digit code for devices not in your account. Use either remote_id or fastcode)

remote_id.description: Device ID (for devices in your account

name: control_connect_state
description: Check remote control session connection status. Use after control_connect when user needs to manually enter verification code.

session_id.description: Remote control session ID

name: control_disconnect
description: Terminate active remote control session. Must re-connect via control_connect if needed again. Disconnect when not in use to release resources.

session_id.description: Remote control session ID

name: control_file_list
description: Browse remote device file directory. Supports path browsing, keyword filter, pagination. Must establish type=file session via control_connect first.

path.description: Parent path to browse (defaults to user directory if not specified)

session_id.description: Remote control session ID (file session only)

name: control_file_mkdir
description: Create folder in remote file session. Must be in established file session.

session_id.description: Remote control session ID (file session only)

name: control_file_remove
description: Delete file or folder in remote file session. Choose recursive deletion for folders.

session_id.description: Remote control session ID (file session only)

name: control_file_rename
description: Rename file or folder in remote file session.

session_id.description: Remote control session ID (file session only)

name: control_file_transfer
description: Create file transfer task. Supports bidirectional: down (remote to local) or up (local to remote). Must establish type=file session via control_connect first. Specify local_path, remote_path, transfer_type. Async transfer, returns transfer_id, use control_file_transfer_state to check progress.

session_id.description: Remote control session ID (file session only)

name: control_file_transfer_cancel
description: Cancel file transfer task in remote file session. Cancel specific task by ID, or all tasks in current session if no ID specified.

session_id.description: Remote control session ID (file session only)

transfer_id.description: Transfer task ID to cancel (cancel all tasks in session if not specified)

name: control_file_transfer_state
description: Query file transfer progress in remote file session. Returns transfer speed, transferred size, remaining time, percentage.

session_id.description: Remote control session ID (file session only)

transfer_id.description: Transfer task ID to query (returns all tasks in session if not specified)

name: control_portforward
description: Configure port forwarding rules in established forward session. Requires active forward session. Enables bidirectional data forwarding between local and remote ports.

session_id.description: Remote control session ID (forward session only)

name: control_screenshot
description: Take screenshot of remote session (desktop/desktop_view/newcamera). Returns Base64 encoded image and dimensions. Use to check current screen state. Only supports desktop, desktop_view, newcamera sessions.

session_id.description: Remote control session ID (desktop/desktop_view/newcamera only)

name: control_sessions
description: Query all active remote control sessions including session_id, type, remote_id, and fastcode. Session_id can be used for screenshot, command execution, desktop operations, and disconnect.

type.description: Filter by session type. Options: file

name: desktop_click_mouse
description: Simulate mouse click in remote desktop. Supports left/right/middle click and double click. Coordinates must be normalized (0.0-1.0): x = x_pixel / width. Use for button clicks, menu selection.

clicks.description: Number of clicks (2 for double click)

session_id.description: Remote control session ID (desktop session only)

name: desktop_drag_mouse
description: Simulate mouse drag in remote desktop. Hold specified button (left/right/middle) and move along path. Use for file drag, window resize, text selection. Path coordinates normalized (0.0-1.0).

hold_keys.description: Keys to hold while dragging: shift

session_id.description: Remote control session ID (desktop session only)

name: desktop_move_mouse
description: Move mouse cursor to specified position in remote desktop. Coordinates normalized (0.0-1.0). Use for positioning before drag, hover to trigger menu, or with screenshot to determine click position. No click triggered.

session_id.description: Remote control session ID (desktop session only)

name: desktop_paste_text
description: Paste text via clipboard in remote desktop. More efficient than character typing. Use for long text, code, commands. Ensure input field has focus and remote supports clipboard sync.

session_id.description: Remote control session ID (desktop session only)

name: desktop_press_keys
description: Control key press/release in remote desktop. Supports down only, up only, or default press-then-release. Use for long press, complex key combinations.

press.description: Key action: up/down (default is press then release. If down

session_id.description: Remote control session ID (desktop session only)

name: desktop_scroll_mouse
description: Simulate mouse wheel scroll at specified position. Supports up or down scroll. Use for scrolling web pages, documents, lists. Coordinates normalized (0.0-1.0).

session_id.description: Remote control session ID (desktop session only)

name: desktop_typing_keys
description: Execute keyboard shortcuts in remote desktop: Ctrl+C, Ctrl+V, Ctrl+S, etc. Presses all keys in sequence, releases in reverse order after delay. Use for multi-key combinations.

session_id.description: Remote control session ID (desktop session only)

name: desktop_typing_text
description: Type text character by character in remote desktop. Ensure input field has focus before typing. Set character delay (ms) to control typing speed.

session_id.description: Remote control session ID (desktop session only)

name: desktop_waiting
description: Pause/wait in operation sequence. Use after critical operations to wait for system response or page load. Specify duration in ms. Recommended for network delay or UI rendering.

duration.description: Wait duration in ms (recommend <=500ms for UI rendering

name: device_add
description: Add a new device to the device list. Set name and description for easy management. After adding, you can query the device via device_search.

name: device_info
description: Get full details of a device including hardware config (CPU, memory, disk, GPU), network info (IP, MAC), system version, online status, supported plugins. Returns fastcode and plugins for connection decisions. Must get remote_id via device_search first.

name: device_remove
description: Remove device from the device list. Only removes the record, not the client software. Cannot recover after deletion. Confirm device is no longer needed before removal.

name: device_search
description: Fuzzy search devices in your account by keyword. Returns device basic info including remote_id, name, online status. Only searches devices under your account, not fastcode devices. If user provides a fastcode (typically 9-10 digits), use control_connect's fastcode parameter directly instead of this tool.

name: device_shutdown
description: Send shutdown command to online remote device. Device must be online and support shutdown. Device will shut down and go offline in 1-2 minutes.

name: device_update
description: Update device name and description for easier identification and management.

name: device_wakeup
description: Send wake-up command to device with Wake-on-LAN hardware. Device needs boot hardware or motherboard supporting WOL. Device will boot and go online in 1-2 minutes.
